Experimental and device-dependent. Keep the iPhone in one orientation for this first test. AR placement uses an estimated floor, not a detected floor mesh.

To compare, place the model, move your shoe near a virtual wall or slab, and toggle between the two rendering modes. This test only accesses your local backup ZIP. It does not sign in to, alter, or copy data from the live Construction AR Lab.
